intent.summary: Arranges children sequentially on the locale-aware inline axis.
useWhen: Sibling order is meaningful and horizontal
Content width should be the sum of child extents and gaps

semantics.sizing: cross-axis size is the maximum child extent; main-axis size is children plus gaps
semantics.ordering: document order follows locale direction unless explicitly fixed

accessibility.nameSource: none unless the group has independent meaning
accessibility.focusBehavior: container is not focusable; descendants retain semantic order
notes: Do not reverse accessibility order solely for visual mirroring.

mappings.strategy: Preserve child order, spacing, vertical alignment, and layout direction.
Use columns when sizing constraints matter; otherwise a horizontal StackPanel is valid.
caveats: FlowDirection must reflect the direction policy.
